Questions, answered.

What does REGEN provide?

Solar generation, battery storage and smart energy management for homes, businesses and communities.

How does solar energy work?

Panels convert sunlight into electricity, which powers your space first, with any surplus stored or shared.

Can REGEN systems store energy?

Yes. Batteries hold excess solar energy for evenings, peak demand or grid outages.

Can REGEN be used for businesses?

Yes. Systems scale from small shops to offices and industrial sites, with 24/7 energy visibility.

How much energy can a solar system generate?

It depends on system size, roof orientation and local sunlight. Figures on this concept site are illustrative.

How does battery storage work?

Surplus electricity charges the battery during the day; the system discharges it when demand rises or supply drops.
